build.//: Three ways to build. Pick one with --profile <name>.

apk.//: An installable Android file, pointing at the live server. This is the one to build once the API is deployed: it works anywhere, on mobile data, like any normal app.

apk-local.//: The same, but pointing at a computer on your own wifi - for testing before the server is live. Run `npm run lan-ip` and put what it prints below.

production.//: For the Play Store. Google requires .aab, not .apk.
